## A Note on Normalising Random Variables

To begin with, we roll a single die a few times:

```{r}
N <- 1000
rolls <- sample(1:6, N, replace = TRUE)
hist(rolls)
```
So, let us now repeat it a few times:

```{r}
plot_avg_rolls <- function(n) {
  N <- 1000
  rolls <- c()
  for (i in 1:n) {
    # Wrong way to assign to vector, since we assign only one value each time
    #rolls[i] <- sample(1:6, N, replace = TRUE)
    # Correct way to assign to vector, creating essentially a matrix
    rolls[[i]] <- sample(1:6, N, replace = TRUE)
  }
  avg_rolls <- rep(0, N) # Create an initially filled with N zeroes vector
  for (i in 1:n) {
    avg_rolls <- avg_rolls + rolls[[i]]
  }
  hist(avg_rolls)
}
plot_avg_rolls(5)
```
We can now try to roll 32 dice:

```{r}
plot_avg_rolls(32)
```
